node.title: XR deficient active-defect family: low-affine-span payment
node.statement: For the exact punctured parameter list of a D-local deficient Pade family, an affine dimension-s parameter set has size at most floor(C(R+ell-e+s,s)/C(d+ell+s,s)). Over the full official active-defect range this cap is maximized at d=ceil((2h+2)/3), ell=1, e=2(h-d). Exact integer evaluation pays the SL2-D budget through affine dimensions 9,9,8 at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16. Hence every counterexample has affine parameter dimension at least 10,10,9 respectively.
